title: Subjects can be aspects of other subjects

statements.text: Cosmopsychism entails subject-subsuming subjects, conscious subjects that are aspects of other conscious subjects. They cannot be imagined, but neither can a four-dimensional object, which is coherent. What the cosmopsychist takes as fundamental is a conscious universe that contains other subjects as partial aspects, which may be the one view that escapes the conceivability worries.
